object.description: Setup: debug build, database viewer, heart rate sensor paired. Steps: 1. Record a 5 min session wearing the sensor and finish it. 2. Record a 60 s session with no sensor paired and finish it. 3. Read the stored average and maximum heart rate of both workouts. Expected: The first workout holds the average and maximum heart rate shown on its Summary screen; the second holds empty values, not 0. HeartRateAccumulatorTest proves the calculation only, not the stored values.
